card.name: Digits inside numbers and dose tables
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit partway through a multi-digit number, such as the 0 in $800 or 1 in 12 hours, and sometimes the end of 'sinusitis' in dosing tables.

modes.label: Digits in prices and figures
modes.description: A digit inside a dollar amount or other number, often a trailing 0 or 9.

modes.label: Dose-table interval digits
modes.description: A digit in a dosing interval such as every 12 hours, in antibiotic indication tables.
